producer_report.summary: Job planning now runs up to max_rounds (default 3) of planner, Athena's own checks, then critic. A revise sends a revision brief quoting the previous plan and every finding. Reject, a misread reading, or a revise in the last round fails the job with "planning stopped before any code was written:" plus the findings. The stopped job scores verification_passes as unknown, not false (F11). A retry carries the stopping critique's findings (F11). Athena's checks live in admission::plan_findings. A major finding writes an Athena critique with no critic invocation and goes back to the planner. A critic that accepts while holding a major or blocker finding is treated as revise. The full cargo test --locked, clippy and fmt pass.

checks_run.note: Run as `cargo test --locked -q --no-fail-fast` over the whole workspace, after fixing one failure of my own (external_calls_guard rejected a shell-download program name in a test string; reworded). open_issues: Scoring: a job with planner or critic invocations and no producer or verifier invocation scores verification_passes as unknown. That includes a job that was killed during planning, and a budget stop between an accepted plan and the producer. Recovery of a job killed during planning is out of scope, and I judged this acceptable.
A job that stops before the first planner call, on the budget check, has no planning invocation. It still scores as a failed verification.

athena-score/src/lib.rs is outside the listed deliverables. It was needed to make verification_passes unknown (F11) in the Score record. plan.rs, briefs.rs, outputs.rs, fake.rs and config.rs needed no change.

If the planner is called and the critic then cannot run, or the budget stops the job in round N, that round's plan is stored only in the budget case. A critic that cannot run or errors leaves that round's plan record out; its planner invocation is still committed.
I did not run `cargo test -p xtask` as its own command; it passed inside the workspace run.
mistakes: My first test used a shell-download program name as the out-of-grant command, which tripped external_calls_guard. I reworded it to `python3 check_greeting.py`, which is also outside the grant.
The first clippy run failed with large_enum_variant on RoundEnd. I boxed the PlanRevision.
learnings: JobPlanConfig already had max_rounds (default 3), so athena-data/src/config.rs needed no change.

The Happened.verification_passed field is written in run.rs but not read by scoring. The scored verification_passes event comes from athena_score::score_records, which treated any dispatched job with no verification as false. The unknown result therefore needed a change in athena-score.
crates/athena-core/tests/external_calls_guard.rs scans tracked files, tests included, for names of programs that make network calls, so test strings must avoid them.
Policy::root must exist for evaluate(); plan_findings uses the job's state directory as the root.
fake::deterministic_turn needed no change: the new test Scenario fields script planner and critic turns by call index.
